sourceClarifications: 24.6: The parallel-plate design at minimum gap has d/r about 0.236, so the numerical geometry is an idealized estimate with possible fringing corrections.
24.25: Energy at 200 V is 1.80 microjoules from the given charge and voltage.
24.27: Charge per capacitor and total terminal charge are distinguished; their parallel/series ratios differ.
24.52: C1 and C2 are series, in parallel with C3, then in series with C4. Diagram was visually checked and independently solved with nodal charge conservation.
24.53: C1 is in series with the middle C2 || (C3 series C4) network and C5. There are no equipotential bridge nodes. Equivalent capacitance is 2.52 microfarads.
24.54: Hair density is 65 micrograms per centimetre, not milligrams in extracted text.
24.57: Recalculation without premature rounding gives final parallel energy 1.22472 millijoules.
24.76: Choice (b) is 3 microjoules; choice (d) is 3 picojoules. The ideal capacitor energy change is about 2.51 picojoules.
